summary: Paczka 7 (privacy/sharing/limits/reminders/e-mail templates) tested end-to-end. Backend: new pytest suite test_iter57_paczka7.py, 25/25 passing (visibility, anon profile, 403 vehicle_private, owner as_public preview, stranger blocked, 7-car/7-photo limits (402), AI weekly quota, listing-draft w/o VIN/plate, reminders CRUD + invalid date 400, cron 403 without/with wrong secret, admin dry run, 8 templates x PL/EN preview 200, unknown template 404, waitlist stats). Frontend (Playwright, desktop + mobile EN): all 12 requested flows verified. Found & fixed 1 HIGH frontend bug (public profile name/avatar empty). Found 1 backend logic bug (legacy privacy.profile_visible overrides new visibility toggle).

critical.issue: If vehicle has legacy privacy.profile_visible=false (still toggleable in Overview 'Prywatność' panel → 'Profil widoczny publicznie'), toggling to public via share menu / garage badge returns visibility:'public' and toast 'Profil pojazdu jest teraz publiczny', but vehicle_visibility() still forces private → anon /vehicles/{slug} returns 403 'To auto jest prywatne' and share link is dead. Reproduced via /tmp/p7_conflict.py. Fix: set privacy.profile_visible = (vis=='public') in set_visibility (and return vehicle_visibility(fresh)), or remove/rewire the legacy profile_visible toggle in OverviewTab.js:170.

minor.issue: EN uses hardcoded 'https://sharago.com' while PL uses _app_url(); in preview process env APP_URL=https://664209d9-...preview.emergentagent.com (stale host injected by env, overrides .env sharago.pl) so draft 'Pełna historia' link points to another preview host. Use one env-driven site URL per lang.
Polish plural: 'N wpisów' wrong for 2-4 (wpisy) and 1 (wpis).

logo_url = {SITES[lang]}/email/logo.png → https://sharago.pl/email/logo.png currently 404 (file exists only in frontend/public/email/logo.png on preview); admin preview shows broken image. OK after prod deploy, but verify sharago.com (EN) also serves it.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by tester: name (pp-name) and avatar initial were empty ('?') because code read card.name/card.avatar while API returns card.user.{name,avatar,created_at}. Now merges card.user into card.

vf-mileage-current has HTML `required`, so the browser-native English tooltip 'Please fill out this field.' appears and the PL toast forms.mileageRequired is never reached. Remove `required` (or add noValidate on form) to get the intended PL toast.
Sold card shows two badges 'SPRZEDANE' and 'SPRZEDANY' (duplicate).

integration_issues.flow: Share menu / visibility badge vs Overview Prywatność panel
integration_issues.issue: See backend critical issue – toggle shows 'public' but car stays private if legacy profile_visible toggle was turned off.

issues: 'W Sharago od listopad 2026' – wrong case; should be 'listopada 2026' (use month genitive / format 'LLLL' vs 'MMMM').

design_issues.screen: Vehicle Terms card / Add vehicle 'Data zakupu'
issues: Native browser <input type=date> (shows mm/dd/yyyy US format in PL UI) instead of shadcn calendar; term list shows ISO '2026-12-15' rather than PL date format.
No header/logo/login CTA; 'No photo' and 'SELLER' untranslated in PL.
User fills whole form before learning about 7-car limit; consider showing limit modal on /garage/new open when at limit.
Badge labels are 'PRYWATNY/PUBLICZNY' while form radios say 'Prywatne/Publiczne' – inconsistent wording.

action_items: HIGH: Make POST /vehicles/{id}/visibility also set privacy.profile_visible to match (or drop the legacy 'Profil widoczny publicznie' toggle in OverviewTab) so share/badge toggles actually publish the car
Remove `required` from vf-mileage-current (or noValidate) so the PL toast shows
Fix 'od listopad' → 'od listopada' month case on public profile
Remove duplicate SPRZEDANE/SPRZEDANY badge on sold cards
Unify listing-draft site URL (no hardcoded sharago.com) and Polish plural for 'wpisów'
Translate 'No photo', 'SELLER', 'SPECIFICATIONS', 'Upload photos' in PL; add header to anonymous listing page
Replace native date inputs in VehicleTerms with shadcn date picker; show PL date format
critical_code_review_comments: visibility.py has two sources of truth (visibility and privacy.profile_visible) – the new toggle endpoints write only one; consolidate.
set_visibility response returns raw stored 'visibility' instead of effective vehicle_visibility(fresh) – UI can show a state that is not effective.
PublicProfile.js expected flat card shape; backend _build_card nests under card.user – keep a single contract (fixed on frontend).
routers/vehicles.py is 1343 lines and admin.py 1103 lines – exceed 700-line guideline; split.

success_rate.backend: 96% (25/25 tests pass; 1 logic bug found outside requested scenarios)
success_rate.frontend: 92% (all 12 requested flows work after tester fix; minor UI issues)

seed_data_creation: Temporary TEST_P7 users/vehicles created via /tmp/p7_seed.py and deleted by id (/tmp/p7_cleanup.py). Pytest module cleans its own users by id. One dry-run job_runs entry (dry_run:true) added by admin dry run. No real reminders/emails sent, admin password unchanged.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use test_iter57_paczka7.py (run with -p no:xdist). Login in UI by setting localStorage sharago_token (user) / sharago_admin_token (admin, get via POST /api/admin/login with random True-Client-IP). Dismiss first-use tooltips by clicking [data-testid=first-use-tooltips-overlay] (it intercepts clicks on garage). Retest: profile_visible conflict (/tmp/p7_conflict.py approach), mileage toast, month case.
